messages.content: How to design a cathedral style ceiling?

function.name: building_information_get_data
function.description: Retrieve information about a specific building or monument Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

building_name.description: The name of the building or monument.

info_requested.description: The specific information requested about the building or monument. For example, 'height', 'architect', etc.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "How to design a cathedral style ceiling?" They want guidance on designing a cathedral style ceiling. We can provide steps, considerations, architectural elements, structural aspects, materials, lighting, acoustics, etc. Also mention typical features: ribbed vaults, flying buttresses, stained glass, etc. Provide design process: conceptualization, structural analysis, material selection, detailing, finishing, lighting, acoustics, cost, sustainability. Also mention software tools: CAD, BIM, 3D modeling, structural analysis. Provide references to building codes, safety, etc. Provide a step-by-step guide. Also mention typical dimensions, load calculations, etc. Provide a sample design outline. Also mention how to incorporate modern elements. Provide a checklist. Provide resources. Provide a summary. Also mention potential pitfalls. Provide a design example. Provide a diagram? Can't produce images but can describe.
